paper_title: Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for   Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation
caption: Results of different schema linking modules on BIRD-dev.
model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates the performance results of different schema linking modules on the BIRD-dev dataset. The horizontal axis categorizes the data into three evaluation metrics, ordered from left to right as Recall, Precision, and F1 Score. The vertical value axis presents a linear numeric scale ranging from 40 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 20; it does not have an explicit axis label or units. The chart features vertical bars arranged in groups of three for each of the categories on the horizontal axis. According to the legend at the top, the bars within each group are color-coded to represent three specific methods: a light blue bar for "DIN-SQL (zero-shot)", a dark blue bar for "TA-SQL (zero-shot)", and a light green bar for "DIN-SQL (few-shot)". Every bar is visually emphasized by an exact numeric annotation placed just above its top edge. Visually, within every group, the bar heights consistently increase in order from light blue to dark blue to light green. For the Recall metric, the annotated values are 63.58 for the light blue bar (which is the shortest bar in the entire chart), 71.90 for the dark blue bar, and 72.29 for the light green bar. The Precision metric contains the highest overall scores, showing 88.89 for light blue, 91.24 for dark blue, and 92.31 for light green, making this light green bar the tallest in the chart. Lastly, the F1 Score group displays values of 75.34 for light blue, 80.40 for dark blue, and 81.08 for light green.
